lines.en: label shrine5:
scene shrine_noon
Once again, I find myself at the shrine without much of an objective in mind.
lines.zh: 我又一次来到神社，心里并没有什么明确的目标。

lines.en: I’ve been coming here a lot lately for reasons beyond my comprehension...but even with that, Maya seems no more open to talking to me than she did when I showed up for the first time.
lines.zh: 最近我常来这儿，理由连我自己都无法理解……可即便如此，Maya 似乎也没比我第一次出现时更愿意跟我说话。

lines.en: Well, the first time by my standards at least. I have no idea how frequently the {i}last{/i} me showed up. But judging by her reaction, I can't imagine it was all that often.
lines.zh: 好吧，至少是按我的标准来说的第一次。我不知道「{i}上一个{/i}」我多久来一次。不过从她的反应来看，我想应该不算太频繁。

lines.en: In fact, speaking of Maya...where is she? I feel like she normally questions my existence by now. And if she's not here, I really have no reason to-
lines.zh: 话说回来，Maya 呢？我觉得她平时这会儿早该开始质疑我的存在了。要是她不在，我就真没什么理由——
: 为什么？……

lines.en: : Why do you keep doing this?
lines.zh: : 你为什么一直这么做？

lines.en: scene mayasweep1
: You are already aware that I want nothing to do with you, so why? Why do you continue to show up {i}here{/i} despite that?
lines.zh: : 你明知道我根本不想和你有任何牵扯，那为什么？既然如此，你为什么还要一直出现在{i}这里{/i}？

lines.en: : I really wish I had a good reason to give you.
lines.zh: : 我真希望自己能给你一个像样的理由。

lines.en: : Do you have a good reason for literally anything at any point? Because I really just can't imagine that.
lines.zh: : 你有在任何时候、对任何事给出过像样的理由吗？因为我真的想象不出来。

lines.en: : Maybe I was just wondering what you were up to? Am I not allowed to show up and...check on my niece's best friend?
lines.zh: : 也许我只是想知道你在做什么？难道我不该来看看我[niece]的闺蜜吗？

lines.en: : I’m doing the same thing I do every weekend. Does that answer your question? Are you ready to go home now?
lines.zh: : 我在做每个周末都做的事。这回答你的问题了吗？现在可以回家了吗？

lines.en: : You’re in a different spot than normal, so you're clearly not doing the same thing you do {i}every{/i} weekend.
lines.zh: : 你站的位置跟平时不一样，所以你显然不是在做{i}每个{/i}周末都做的事。

lines.en: : This may come as a surprise to you, but I have a tendency to move around at various points in the day.
lines.zh: : 你可能不知道，我一天里是会到处走动的。

lines.en: : You mean you {i}don't{/i} stop existing the second I take my eyes off of you?
lines.zh: : 你是说，我一把视线移开，你并{i}不会{/i}就停止存在？

lines.en: : No, but I often wish I did.
lines.zh: : 不会，不过我常常希望自己会。

lines.en: : So, do you have some time to spare? We might as well talk since I'm already here, right?
lines.zh: : 那么，你有空吗？既然我都来了，我们不妨聊聊，对吧？

lines.en: scene mayasweep2
: Wrong. This is actually the part where we forget you ever came here and simply move on with our lives.
lines.zh: : 不对。现在应该是我们假装你从没来过这儿，然后各自继续过日子的时候。

lines.en: : I’ve already told you that I have no intention of getting to know you and the fact that you are continuing to disregard that is really starting to grate on me.
lines.zh: : 我已经说过了，我没打算去了解你，而你继续无视我说的话，真的开始让我恼火了。

lines.en: : I understand that. But what I don't understand is {i}why?{/i} What did I ever do to you?
lines.zh: : 我明白。但我不明白的是——{i}为什么？{/i}我到底对你做过什么？

lines.en: scene mayasweep3
: You? Nothing in particular- but that's likely because I haven't let you.
lines.zh: : 你？没什么特别的——不过那大概是因为我没给你机会。

lines.en: : I don't-
lines.zh: : 我不——

lines.en: : Do you believe that someone needs to have wronged you in order to avoid them?
lines.zh: : 你觉得，一个人非得先得罪你，你才有理由躲着他吗？

lines.en: : Well, no. But-
lines.zh: : 嗯，不是。可是——

lines.en: : Then I suggest you take issue with someone or {i}something{/i} else.
lines.zh: : 那我建议你去找别人、或者别的{i}东西{/i}计较。

lines.en: : I am in no position to be associating with you right now. Or...ever, for that matter.
lines.zh: : 我现在没有立场和你来往。或者……说到底，永远都不会有。

lines.en: : In no position? What does that mean?
lines.zh: : 没有立场？什么意思？

lines.en: : It means that simply being {i}near{/i} you has the potential to greatly alter both of our paths. And that the impending fallout would bring nothing but harm to everyone and everything.
lines.zh: : 意思是，光是待在你{i}附近{/i}，就有可能大大改变我们两人的人生轨迹。而随之而来的后果，只会给所有人和一切带来伤害。

lines.en: : That seems like a pretty major repercussion for just trying to learn about you.
lines.zh: : 只是想多了解你一点，听起来后果还挺严重的。

lines.en: : It does. Doesn't it?
lines.zh: : 是啊。可不是嘛。

lines.en: : Let's just talk. That's all I want.
lines.zh: : 我们就聊聊吧。我就想要这个。

lines.en: scene mayasweep4
: No. I am very much content with who and what I have now, and I will not back down from that stance just because a man old enough to be my grandfather wants to {i}talk to me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 不。我对现在的自己和现在的生活非常满意，我不会因为一个老到能当我爷爷的男人想「{i}跟我聊聊{/i}」就退让。

lines.en: : Okay, now that was an exaggeration and you know it. You could pass for my daughter at best.
lines.zh: : 好了，这就夸张了，你自己也知道。你顶多算能当我女儿。

lines.en: scene mayasweep2
: It doesn’t make a difference how old you are, really.
lines.zh: : 你多大年纪其实没什么差别。

lines.en: : You are you and I am me.
lines.zh: : 你是你，我是我。

lines.en: : We live in different worlds.
lines.zh: : 我们活在不同的世界里。

lines.en: : Doesn't that contradict that whole thing you said about us living in the same world?
lines.zh: : 这难道不和你之前说的「我们活在同一个世界」那套话矛盾吗？

lines.en: : Have you never heard of a figure of speech before, you pathetic excuse for a man?
lines.zh: : 你从没听说过「修辞手法」这种东西吗，你这个可悲的、勉强算男人的东西？

lines.en: : Wow. My bad.
lines.zh: : 哇。我的错。

lines.en: : As I was saying...we live in different worlds.
lines.zh: : 我刚才说的是……我们活在不同的世界里。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...your friends don’t seem to think that.
lines.zh: : 是吗，嗯……你的朋友们似乎不这么想。

lines.en: scene mayasweep3
: That's true. Because their judgement has been clouded by a skewed- no. A {i}mutilated{/i} perception of you.
lines.zh: : 这话没错。因为她们的判斷力被一种扭曲的——不，是被「{i}肢解{/i}」过的——对你的认知给蒙蔽了。

lines.en: : As unfortunate as it is to say this, I'm the only one who knows what you really are and what you hope to gain in this {i}exciting{/i} new life of yours.
lines.zh: : 说来遗憾，我是唯一一个知道你到底是什么人、以及你在这「{i}崭新{/i}」的人生里想要得到什么的人。

lines.en: : But to everyone else? You're the same person you've always been.
lines.zh: : 可在其他人眼里？你还是那个你一直是的人。

lines.en: : In fact, you're likely even {i}better{/i} to them now than you've always been since the {i}real{/i} you wasn't all that great either.
lines.zh: : 事实上，对她们来说，你现在搞不好比以前{i}更好{/i}，毕竟「{i}真正{/i}的」你也没好到哪儿去。

lines.en: : How fun it must be to start off several steps above {i}unremarkable.{/i} Think of how many boobies you'll get to see if you play your cards right.
lines.zh: : 从一个比「{i}平庸{/i}」还高几级的起点开始，一定很有意思吧。想想看，要是你牌打得好，能看到多少奶子。

lines.en: : Hearing you say “boobies” makes me feel weird.
lines.zh: : 听到你说「奶子」，我感觉怪怪的。

lines.en: : Hearing you say anything at all makes me feel weird. And by weird, I mean nauseous.
lines.zh: : 听到你说任何话，我都感觉怪怪的。而这个怪，指的是恶心。

lines.en: : To me, you are nothing more than a worm. But to Ami and Ayane, you're the same man they’ve known since childhood. So it's no wonder they're as...forward about their feelings as they are.
lines.zh: : 对我来说，你不过是一条虫子。可对 Ami 和 Ayane 来说，你是她们从小就认识的那个男人。所以她们才会那么……直白地表达感情。

lines.en: : The rest are sure to follow suit. It's simply the way things work here.
lines.zh: : 剩下的那些人肯定也会跟上。这里的事情就是这么运转的。

lines.en: : But I am an outlier. I am an exception to that.
lines.zh: : 可我是个异类。我是个例外。

lines.en: : And no amount of shrine visits or half-hearted attempts to disrobe me are going to change that.
lines.zh: : 而无论你跑多少趟神社、无论你多么半心半意地想把我的衣服扒掉，都改变不了这一点。

lines.en: scene mayasweep2
: What? Have you finally run out of things to say?
lines.zh: : 怎么？你终于没话说了？

lines.en: : It's less that I've run out of things to say and more that I’m still just...kind of confused about who you are.
lines.zh: : 与其说没话说了，不如说我还是……有点搞不懂你是谁。

lines.en: : Or {i}what{/i} you are.
lines.zh: : 或者说，你「是」{i}什么{/i}。

lines.en: : {i}What?{/i} Is that supposed to be some sort of insult?
lines.zh: : 「{i}什么{/i}」？那是某种侮辱吗？

lines.en: : Not really. Just a...skeptical inquiry.
lines.zh: : 不算。只是一个……带着怀疑的提问。

lines.en: : Well, I am sorry to disappoint you...but I'm a normal teenage girl.
lines.zh: : 嗯，很抱歉让你失望了……我只是个普通的少女。

lines.en: : I don't think normal teenage girls typically talk about how normal they are.
lines.zh: : 我觉得普通的少女通常不会反复强调自己有多普通。

lines.en: : Oh? And how many others have you pressed with the same line of questioning?
lines.zh: : 哦？那你又对多少人追问过同样的问题？

lines.en: : None. But even if I did, I doubt they'd respond like...{i}that.{/i}
lines.zh: : 一个也没有。不过就算有，我怀疑她们也不会像你{i}那样{/i}回答。

lines.en: : Would it make you feel better if I spoke more like them? Would it get you any closer to leaving?
lines.zh: : 要是我说话更像她们一点，你会不会好受些？会不会让你离走人更近一点？

lines.en: : Maya-
lines.zh: : Maya——

lines.en: scene mayasweep5
: Good evening, Sensei! I'm sorry to bother you, but I was wondering if you'd be able to help me with my homework after school.
lines.zh: : 晚上好，Sensei！抱歉打扰你，不过我在想，放学后你能不能帮我辅导作业？

lines.en: : Then, perhaps afterward...we could maybe hold hands and talk about all of the things we like about one another? Doesn't that sound fantastic?
lines.zh: : 然后……也许之后……我们可以牵着手，聊聊彼此喜欢对方哪些地方？听起来是不是棒极了？

lines.en: Maya’s voice moves up an octave or two as an incredibly off-putting impression finds its way out of her mouth.
lines.zh: Maya 的嗓音提高了几个八度，一段极其让人不适的模仿从她嘴里冒了出来。

lines.en: scene mayasweep3
: There. Was that more in-line with what you've grown used to over your short time here?
lines.zh: : 这样。是不是更符合你在这儿的短短时间里所习惯的样子？

lines.en: : Not really. And, for the record- saying things like that, even if they're done jokingly, doesn't really fit within the lines your character has drawn for itself so far.
lines.zh: : 不太符合。顺便说一句——哪怕是以开玩笑的方式说这种话，也完全不符合你的角色到目前为止给自己画下的那些线。

lines.en: scene mayasweep6
: What does it even mean to ‘fit?’
lines.zh: : 「符合」到底是什么意思？

lines.en: : Is it time to get existential again?
lines.zh: : 又到了谈玄说虚的时间了？

lines.en: scene mayasweep1
: Perhaps. That {i}is{/i} within the lines I've allegedly drawn, is it not?
lines.zh: : 也许吧。这「{i}确实{/i}」在我据说画下的那些线之内，不是吗？

lines.en: : It's-
: That was a rhetorical question. I know who I am and how I speak.
lines.zh: : 那是个反问句。我知道我是谁，也知道自己怎么说话。

lines.en: : What I don't know is why {i}you{/i} seem to believe that things should always appear as you expect or want them to without making a conscious effort to mold them into that form.
lines.zh: : 我不知道的是，为什么「{i}你{/i}」似乎相信，事情永远该按你期望或想要的样子呈现，而不必主动花力气把它们塑造成那个样子。

lines.en: : You're like a...3D puzzle piece trying to blend in with 2D ones atop the coffee table of...some old person who likes puzzles.
lines.zh: : 你就像一块……3D 拼图，试图融入咖啡桌上那堆 2D 拼图——而那张咖啡桌属于某个喜欢拼图的老年人。

lines.en: : I feel like that wasn't as strong as a lot of your other analogies.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这个比喻没有你其他那些比喻来得有力。

lines.en: : What I'm trying to ask is...do you think that {i}you{/i} fit anywhere?
lines.zh: : 我想问的是……你觉得「你」{i}自己{/i}适合待在什么地方吗？

lines.en: : Sure. I think I fit in pretty well here, at least.
lines.zh: : 当然。我觉得我在这儿适应得挺好的，至少。

lines.en: scene mayasweep6
: Do you? Or do you just {i}think{/i} you do because you’re assuming the role you were placed into?
lines.zh: : 是吗？还是说你只是「{i}以为{/i}」自己适应得好，因为你在扮演一个被硬塞给你的角色？

lines.en: : You got a head start. Everyone already loves you.
lines.zh: : 你占了先手。大家已经都爱你了。

lines.en: : But you know for a fact that they wouldn't if they could see what I see.
lines.zh: : 可你心里清楚，如果她们能看到我看到的东西，就不会爱了。

lines.en: I’m not really sure how to respond to that.
lines.zh: 我真不知道该怎么回应。

lines.en: Not because I’m shocked, but because Maya has managed to pinpoint my exact situation with virtually no hesitation at all.
lines.zh: 不是因为震惊，而是因为 Maya 几乎毫不犹豫地就精准点出了我的处境。

lines.en: This life is only working as well as it is right now because I’m pretending to be someone else.
lines.zh: 现在这人生之所以运转得还算顺利，是因为我在假装成另一个人。

lines.en: Or at least living inside of their skin and letting my intuition guide me rather than any goals or concrete thoughts.
lines.zh: 或者至少是活在他的皮囊里，任由直觉引导我，而不是靠什么目标或具体的想法。

lines.en: But...how am I supposed to do anything but that?
lines.zh: 可是……除此之外我还能怎么做？

lines.en: How can I emulate a person I never knew in real life?
lines.zh: 我要怎么去模仿一个我在现实中从未认识过的人？

lines.en: How can I fill these shoes without knowing the shape of the feet that resided within them before mine, burned by the coals of uncertainty, slipped inside?
lines.zh: 我要怎么填满这双鞋，却毫不知道在我之前滑进去的那些脚是什么形状——那些被不确定性的炭火灼伤过的脚。

lines.en: scene mayasweep3
: Is your sudden silence a sign of agreement?
lines.zh: : 你突然沉默，是表示同意吗？

lines.en: : Who are you?
lines.zh: : 你是谁？

lines.en: : I already told you.
lines.zh: : 我说过了。

lines.en: : I’m a normal [teenage]girl.
lines.zh: : 我是一个普通的[teenage]女孩。

lines.en: : Nothing more, nothing less.
lines.zh: : 不多不少。

lines.en: : You think it’s normal to talk about things like alternate worlds and reincarnation?
lines.zh: : 你觉得谈论什么平行世界、轮回转世之类的事很正常？

lines.en: : Do you think it’s normal not to?
lines.zh: : 你觉得那不正常吗？

lines.en: : When you’re the only person who’s even mentioned something like that to me so far, yeah. I kind of do.
lines.zh: : 到目前为止，你是唯一一个跟我提过这种事的人，所以，是啊，我确实觉得不正常。

lines.en: : Maybe everyone else is strange? Maybe {i}I'm{/i} the normal one?
lines.zh: : 也许奇怪的是其他所有人？也许「{i}我{/i}」才是正常的那一个？

lines.en: : Are you sure that you’re not some type of...omniscient being or something like that?
lines.zh: : 你确定你不是某种……全知的存在之类的？

lines.en: : You’re a shrine maiden. So if anyone here has some sort of {i}divine influence{/i} or something-
lines.zh: : 你是巫女。所以如果这儿有谁带点「{i}神性影响{/i}」什么的——

lines.en: scene mayasweep2
: If I had this so-called {i}divine influence{/i} you speak of, don’t you think I would have taken advantage of it by now to make you leave me alone?
lines.zh: : 要是我真有你说的那种「{i}神性影响{/i}」，你不觉得我早该利用它让你别来烦我了吗？

lines.en: : Not if you actually {i}enjoy{/i} my company and are just pretending not to.
lines.zh: : 除非你其实「{i}享受{/i}」我的陪伴，只是在假装不享受。

lines.en: scene mayasweep1
: Ha ha ha. The tsundere role is already filled at our school, I’m afraid.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈。可惜啊，我们学校里傲娇这个角色已经有人演了。

lines.en: : There can be two. There's no rule against that.
lines.zh: : 可以有两个啊。又没有规定说不行。

lines.en: : Are we done here? Because I would like to go back to sweeping before the sun sets.
lines.zh: : 我们说完了吗？我想在太阳下山前继续扫地。

lines.en: : As you can see, this shrine is very large and I am the only person here holding a broom.
lines.zh: : 你也看到了，这座神社很大，而这儿只有我一个人拿着扫帚。

lines.en: : And looking very good while doing it.
lines.zh: : 而且扫地的时候还特别好看。

lines.en: scene mayasweep3
: I truly wonder if you will ever make it through an entire conversation without hitting on me.
lines.zh: : 我真怀疑你这一辈子有没有可能完整聊完一次天而不调戏我。

lines.en: : I think I did a lot better than usual today, so who knows? If I keep improving at this rate, maybe we’ll even start getting along soon?
lines.zh: : 我觉得今天比平时做得好多了，谁知道呢？要是照这个速度继续进步，说不定我们很快就能和睦相处了？

lines.en: : Or maybe we won’t and you’ll give up on me entirely.
lines.zh: : 也说不定不会，然后你就彻底放弃我了。

lines.en: : Sorry, but I can't really see a future where that happens.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我真的看不到那样的未来。

lines.en: scene mayasweep2
: I'm sure there's one out there somewhere.
lines.zh: : 我相信在某个地方一定存在。

lines.en: : There has to be...
lines.zh: : 一定得有……

lines.en: scene mayasweep3
: Now, please leave. You have insulted this place enough by once again refusing to pray.
lines.zh: : 现在，请你离开。你又一次不肯参拜，已经把这里侮辱得够呛了。

lines.en: : And the fact that you are now attempting to woo your [niece]’s best friend is only making things worse. The gods are sure to smite you at this rate.
lines.zh: : 而你如今还试图勾引你[niece]的闺蜜，只会让事情更糟。再这样下去，神明肯定会降下天罚的。

lines.en: : Okay, okay. I’ll go.
lines.zh: : 好好好。我走。

lines.en: : But I'm not going to apologize for bothering you and I want you to know that it is only going to get worse from here on out.
lines.zh: : 但我不会为打扰你而道歉，而且我希望你明白——接下来只会变本加厉。

lines.en: scene mayasweep2
: Unfortunately, this is one of very few times in my life where I feel obligated to agree with you.
lines.zh: : 很不幸，这是我这辈子为数不多觉得自己不得不赞同你的时候。

lines.en: : I'll see you later, Maya.
lines.zh: : 回头见，Maya。

lines.en: : Please don't.
lines.zh: : 请别。

lines.en: scene black
I begin to descend down the shrine's obnoxiously long flight of stairs back to the streets, unsure of what to do with the rest of my day.
lines.zh: 我开始走下神社那长得离谱的台阶，回到街上，不知道这一天剩下的时间该怎么打发。

lines.en: I don't want to say I've given up on ever understanding Maya at this point, but...
lines.zh: 我不想说我已经放弃了有朝一日理解 Maya……

lines.en: Well, let's just say I've got a lot of work to put in if I ever actually want that to happen...
lines.zh: 好吧，只能说，如果我真想让那件事发生，要下的功夫还多着呢……

lines.en: $ shrine5 = True
